title: Media Buyer | Cellexia Labs
description:
Pay: PHP 130k to 170k Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.
In skincare, the ad is where the relationship starts. A stranger scrolling past on a phone gives us a second or two, and in that time the ad has to earn a look, a click, and the start of trust. Done well, it brings in customers who stay and reorder. Done badly, it burns budget on people who were never going to buy.
This role runs that moment. You'll own our Meta advertising: what we test, what we scale, where the budget goes, and how we know it's working. It's work where decisions turn into numbers within days, and every number tells you something.
For a sharp, driven media buyer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of a growing brand's biggest growth channel.
A few examples of your responsibilities
Own the Meta ad account. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across our markets. You'll decide the structure, the audiences, the budgets, and when to scale or cut.
Build a testing engine. Run a steady stream of tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, and offers. Know what you're testing, why, and what you'll do with the result.
Scale what works. Find the winners, push spend up without breaking performance, and keep acquisition profitable as budgets grow.
Work hand in hand with the creative team. Turn what the data shows into clear briefs for our writers and video editors, so the next round of ads is sharper than the last.
Make the numbers trustworthy. Keep tracking and attribution clean, so every decision rests on data you can believe. Report on cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and customer quality.
Take every market seriously. Adapt campaigns to the tastes, budgets, and buying habits of customers in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and beyond.
Keep the account healthy. Know Meta's ad policies, especially for skincare claims, and keep our campaigns compliant and our account in good standing.
Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.
What we look for
Analytical mind. You read the numbers and know what they mean. You can tell a real signal from noise, and explain why a campaign is working or not.
Hands-on skill. You've managed Meta ad accounts with real budgets and understand how structure, creative, and audience work together.
Creative instinct. You can tell a strong ad from a weak one before the data does, and you can explain why in words a writer or editor can use.
Ownership. You treat every campaign as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.
Calm under pressure. You stay steady when performance dips, find the cause, and act without panicking or hiding the problem.
Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.
Relevant experience. [2+] years running Meta ads for e-commerce or consumer brands, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.
What we offer
Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.
Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.
Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.
Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you decide how to use it.

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Work location: fully remote

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

description:
Duties and Responsibilities
Manage multiple projects from kickoff through completion, keeping schedules, budgets, and deliverables on track.

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. At Amgen , if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Medical Value & Access Field Director, Regional Accounts

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead therapeutically aligned activities to develop strategic objectives & tactics in prioritized regional accounts and IDNs. The Medical Value & Access Liaison Field Director is responsible for the following:

• Effectively leads a regional payer team of Medical Value & Access Liaisons (MVALs) toward the implementation of field medical payer activities by communicating expectations and guiding the team to optimize medical strategy, prioritization and performance in support of medical objectives

• Ensure the team achieves legally compliant and clinically significant scientific engagements and activities with population health decision-makers, payers, Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and other healthcare partners in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, and the Amgen Code of Conduct

• Strategic leader who develops and maintains professional relationships with targeted Payer & Integrated Delivery Networks (IDN) population health decision makers relative to the Amgen Oncology, Inflammation, Gen Med & Rare Disease portfolio

• Accompany the team to engagements with healthcare decision-makers and other healthcare collaborators to assess strengths, proficiency and provide timely and constructive performance feedback

• Familiar with data & biotechnology techniques to accelerate health outcomes through enhanced patient identification & access, with a reimagined customer experience

• Apply interactive, aligned discussions, and guided activities to help the team identify career opportunities for growth and leadership within and beyond the Medical Liaison role. This will inspire them to take an active role in their individual career development and enhance their personal and professional potential

• Lead and coordinate MVAL team meetings to support team building, best practice sharing, development, retaining top talent, and the accomplishment of field medical objectives.

• Build upon positive relationships and cross-functional collaboration with key internal collaborators in Global Medical, US Field Sales, Value and Access and Value Marketing teams to facilitate a One- Amgen customer-facing engagement strategy and champion the value of the MVAL team.

• Identify, interview, hire, and onboard qualified MVALs to create a diverse and inclusive team

• Assess MVAL new hire field readiness by assisting Global Learning and Performance in the Amgen portfolio, Payer & healthcare landscape, disease state, and product training, including assistance with post-training proficiency assessment

• Assist Medical leadership in the development of the field medical strategy, tactical goals and objectives, and Scientific Engagement Plans (SEPs)

• Support the strategic planning and field medical value implementation of Managed Care/Payer and national congresses.
